pb-books-guide.step1: Open the bookkeeping desk and choose the client organisation and finance cycle.
pb-books-guide.step2: Create an owner self-client access token in the matching Zoho account region, with only the read and write access needed for your chosen accounting operation.
pb-books-guide.step3: Save the token for this open session. Setup needs no invented customer or item IDs; invoice and settlement work needs explicit mappings.
pb-books-guide.step4: Read the exact proposal and approve it. Master creation, initial opening balances and invoice issue each ask separately.
pb-books-guide.skipped: Choose the correct client organisation and region. Reconnect after locking or reopening the app; a saved token is not an approval.
pb-books-guide.charges: Chausar has not checked its prices. Read its own pricing page before you sign up.
pb-books-guide.checks: This connector is fixture-tested. Preparation reads current provider identities and amounts; each approved write requires exact readback. Live account qualification is not claimed.
pb-books-guide.sends: Sends: only an exact owner-approved supported invoice or credit-note draft, issue action, received settlement payment, missing master or initial organisation opening balance. No email, bank transfer, overwrite or silent retry.
pb-books-guide.limits: Agents can prepare source work but cannot send directly to Zoho. Unsupported tax, currency, inventory and setup profiles stay on the manual bookkeeper path.
